rubric.role_summary: Nuclear engineering role supporting radiation diagnostics, particle-transport simulation, shielding, and radiation safety at a fusion facility.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Nuclear engineering role supporting radiation diagnostics, particle-transport simulation, shielding, and radiation safety at a fusion facility.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Master's or PhD in Nuclear Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
- Strong experience in Monte Carlo particle-transport simulations using MCNP, Geant4, FLUKA, or similar tools.
- Hands-on experience with neutron and gamma detection techniques.
- Knowledge of radiation shielding or dose calculations.
- Proficiency in data analysis and programming using Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar tools.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience working in fusion/fission facilities or similar combined neutron-gamma radiation environments.
- Background in high-energy neutron/gamma transport and shielding.
- Knowledge of advanced radiation-detection technologies.
- Knowledge of radiation shielding, dose calculations, and safety assessments.
- Experience in radiation metrology and calibration techniques.
- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including CNSC, NRC, and IAEA standards.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
